title: The psychology of wealth, empathy and entitlement, with Paul Piff, PhD

sentences.en: Most of us like to think we'd stay grounded if we were suddenly to become very wealthy, that we'd still be our old selves, just with more money.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人都喜欢认为，如果我们突然变得非常富有，我们也能保持脚踏实地，依然是原来的自己，只是钱更多了。

sentences.en: But psychologist research suggests that this might not be true.
sentences.zh: 但心理学研究表明，事实可能并非如此。

sentences.en: In recent years, studies have found that gaining money and status can shift how people see themselves and how they behave toward others.
sentences.zh: 近年来，研究发现，获得金钱和地位会改变人们对自己的看法以及对待他人时的行为方式。

sentences.en: While it was the novelist,
sentences.zh: 小说家...

sentences.en: F.
sentences.zh: F·

sentences.en: Scott Fitzgerald, who wrote that the rich are different from you and me, it is psychologists who have shown this to be true.
sentences.zh: 斯科特·菲茨杰拉德曾写道，富人与你我不同，而心理学家则证明了这一点是正确的。

sentences.en: Today, we're going to talk to a psychologist who studies wealth and the ways in which the rich are indeed different.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将与一位研究财富以及富人确实有何不同之处的心理学家进行交谈。

sentences.en: How do money, status, and power shape people's behavior and beliefs?
sentences.zh: 金钱、地位和权力是如何塑造人们的行为和信仰的？

sentences.en: What are the psychological mechanisms at play?
sentences.zh: 其中起作用的心理机制是什么？

sentences.en: And at a time of rising income inequality, what happens to people's sense of empathy, fairness, and entitlement as the gap between rich and poor widens?
sentences.zh: 在收入不平等加剧的时代，随着贫富差距的拉大，人们的同理心、公平感和特权意识会发生什么变化？

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, the flagship podcast of the American Psychological Association that examines the links between psychological science and everyday life.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《心理学说话》，这是美国心理学协会的旗舰播客，旨在探讨心理科学与日常生活之间的联系。

sentences.en: I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯。

sentences.en: My guest today is Dr. Paul Piff, an associate professor of psychological science at
sentences.zh: 我今天的嘉宾是保罗·皮夫博士，他是加州大学欧文分校的心理科学副教授，

sentences.en: the University of California, Irvine, where he leads the Morality, Emotion, and Social Hierarchy Lab.
sentences.zh: 他在那里领导道德、情感和社会等级实验室。

sentences.en: Dr. Piff studies how economic inequality and social class shape relationships between people and groups.
sentences.zh: 皮夫博士研究经济不平等和社会阶层如何塑造人与人、群体与群体之间的关系。

sentences.en: He's published dozens of peer-reviewed research studies and has discussed his research
sentences.zh: 他发表了数十项同行评审的研究报告，并与各大媒体广泛探讨过他的研究，

sentences.en: widely with media outlets, including the New York Times, the Wall Street Journal, Marketplace, and the PBS NewsHour.
sentences.zh: 包括《纽约时报》、《华尔街日报》、Marketplace节目以及PBS新闻时间。

sentences.en: Dr. Piff, thank you for joining me today.
sentences.zh: 皮夫博士，谢谢你今天能来。

sentences.en: Thanks so much, Kim, for that lovely introduction, and it's a pleasure to be here today.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢金给我的精彩介绍，很高兴今天能来到这里。

sentences.en: I want to start with a question that you pose in your popular TED Talk called
sentences.zh: 我想从你在广受欢迎的TED演讲中提出的一个问题开始，

sentences.en: Does Money Make You Mean?
sentences.zh: 题目是《金钱会让你变得刻薄吗？》

sentences.en: In it, you talk about an experiment you did with a rigged game of monopoly.
sentences.zh: 在演讲中，你谈到了你用一场被操纵的大富翁游戏做的一个实验。

sentences.en: Can you tell our listeners about that research and what you found?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们的听众讲讲那项研究以及你发现了什么吗？

sentences.en: The rigged game of monopoly was really our attempt in the lab to kind of emulate or model some of the features of being wealthy out in the real world.
sentences.zh: 这场被操纵的大富翁游戏，确实是我们试图在实验室里模仿或模拟现实世界中富有的一些特征。

sentences.en: It's hard to do because money is such a complicated thing, and it means so many different things to so many different people, and it comes about in so many
sentences.zh: 这很难做到，因为金钱是一个如此复杂的东西，它对不同的人意味着截然不同的东西，而且它以如此...

sentences.en: different ways in people's lives.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的方式进入人们的生活。

sentences.en: But we wanted to come up with a situation in the lab that allowed us to, within sort of this canned situation of a laboratory environment, create between people the
sentences.zh: 但我们想在实验室里设计一种情境，使我们能够在实验室环境这种标准化的情境中，在人与人之间创造出相对而言......

sentences.en: experience of being, relatively speaking, richer or poorer.
sentences.zh: 更富有或更贫穷的体验。

sentences.en: That's a question that's dogged social scientists for decades because you can't just randomly assign people in the real world to
sentences.zh: 这个问题困扰了社会科学家几十年，因为你不能在现实世界中把人们随机分配为...

sentences.en: being millionaires or to being impoverished and then following them over the course of their lives.
sentences.zh: 百万富翁或穷人，然后追踪他们的一生。

sentences.en: But we thought within a game of monopoly, which everyone's familiar with, or many people are,
sentences.zh: 但我们认为，在一场每个人都很熟悉的大富翁游戏中，或者许多人都熟悉的游戏中，

sentences.en: you could create, within just 10 or 15 minutes, some of the experiences of being wealthy or less wealthy.
sentences.zh: 你可以在短短10到15分钟内，创造出变得富有或不那么富有的某些体验。

sentences.en: And so what we did was brought, we brought in pairs of strangers to the lab and they didn't know each other.
sentences.zh: 所以我们做的是，我们将成对的陌生人带到实验室，他们互相并不认识。

sentences.en: They didn't know what kind of situation they were walking in on.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道自己将要面对的是什么样的情况。

sentences.en: It's just a psychology study after all.
sentences.zh: 毕竟这只是一项心理学研究。

sentences.en: We told them they were going to get to play a game and that to play the game, we were first going to flip a coin.
sentences.zh: 我们告诉他们，他们将玩一个游戏，为了玩这个游戏，我们要先抛一枚硬币。

sentences.en: And we flipped a coin to randomly decide who of those two players, who of those two participants in our study would get to be a rich versus poor player in the game.
sentences.zh: 我们抛硬币来随机决定这两个玩家中的哪一个，也就是我们研究中的哪位参与者，在游戏中成为富有或贫穷的玩家。

sentences.en: Now, my collaborators and I leading up to those first sessions had spent months playing
sentences.zh: 现在，我和我的合作者在那些最初的实验开始前，已经花了几个月的时间玩...

sentences.en: monopoly and trying to figure out like, what, what does this game need to look like to basically get people who experience being somewhat richer or somewhat poor.
sentences.zh: 大富翁，并试图弄清楚，这个游戏应该是什么样的，才能让人们体验到相对较富或相对较穷的感觉。

sentences.en: And so we had done some piloting and we figured out that the more desirable piece or the most desirable piece in monopoly was the
sentences.zh: 所以我们做了一些初步试验，发现大富翁中最令人向往的棋子或是最受欢迎的棋子是...

sentences.en: Rolls Royce.
sentences.zh: 劳斯莱斯。

sentences.en: The least desirable piece in monopoly was the shoe.
sentences.zh: 大富翁中最不受欢迎的棋子是鞋子。

sentences.en: So the flip of the coin randomly assigned one person to be a rich player versus a poor player.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过抛硬币，随机指定一个人成为富裕玩家或贫穷玩家。

sentences.en: The rich player got the Rolls Royce.
sentences.zh: 富有的玩家得到了劳斯莱斯。

sentences.en: The poor player got the shoe.
sentences.zh: 贫穷的玩家得到了鞋子。

sentences.en: The rich player got twice as much money to play the game with.
sentences.zh: 富有玩家在游戏开始时获得的资金是另一方的两倍。

sentences.en: They got $2,000 instead of half of that amount, a thousand.
sentences.zh: 他们得到了2000美元，而不是一半的金额，即1000美元。

sentences.en: When they passed go, they'd collect $200.
sentences.zh: 当他们经过起点（GO）时，他们将领取200美元。

sentences.en: So they got, let's say two times the salary of the poor player who only collected $100 when they went around the board and they got to roll two dice instead of one.
sentences.zh: 所以他们得到的薪水是贫穷玩家的两倍，贫穷玩家绕棋盘一圈只能领到100美元，而且他们可以掷两个骰子而不是一个。

sentences.en: So they got to move around the board a lot faster.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在棋盘上移动的速度要快得多。

sentences.en: And so over the course of 15 minutes, we just surreptitiously observed and recorded what happened and what unfolded in this game.
sentences.zh: 因此，在15分钟的过程中，我们只是秘密地观察和记录了在这个游戏中发生和展开的情况。

sentences.en: And we followed up this game with some surveys where we also measured some other things, but we did this with more than a hundred different pairs of strangers.
sentences.zh: 在这款游戏之后，我们还进行了一些调查，其中也衡量了其他一些指标，我们对100多对不同的陌生人做了这个实验。

sentences.en: And what we found is that, you know, in broad strokes over the course of the 15 minutes, what started out as a kind of, uh, certainly an unfamiliar and kind of strange situation
sentences.zh: 我们发现，你知道的，从宏观来看，在15分钟的过程中，最初这种毫无疑问并不熟悉且有点奇怪的情况...

sentences.en: quickly became a competitive game between two people.
sentences.zh: 迅速演变成两个人之间的竞争游戏。

sentences.en: And they were just, you know, within a couple minutes, people were playing monopoly.
sentences.zh: 他们只是，你知道的，在几分钟内，人们就开始玩大富翁了。

sentences.en: And obviously the person who was assigned to be the rich player had double the advantages in so many ways.
sentences.zh: 显然，被指定为富有玩家的那个人在很多方面都拥有双重优势。

sentences.en: And we noticed their patterns of behavior begin to shift.
sentences.zh: 我们注意到他们的行为模式开始发生变化。

sentences.en: They, um, became more dominant in their behavior.
sentences.zh: 他们的行为，嗯，变得更加强势。

sentences.en: They, for instance, started moving around the board in a louder fashion, um, smacking the board with the piece with their, with their game piece.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们开始以更大声的方式在棋盘上移动，嗯，用他们的游戏棋子猛拍棋盘。

sentences.en: Uh, they took up more space at the board.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们在棋盘上占据了更多的空间。

sentences.en: So they actually became more expansive in their posture.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的姿势实际上变得更加舒展。

sentences.en: Um, they're more likely to fan their money out than to keep it confined to a little stack.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们更有可能把钱扇形展开，而不是把钱收拢成一小叠。

sentences.en: So they're more likely to sort of showcase how well they're doing.
sentences.zh: 所以他们更有可能炫耀自己过得有多好。

sentences.en: And over the course of the game, we noticed that just in their, uh, nonverbal behavior to the other person, they became way less sort of sensitive to the plight of the poor
sentences.zh: 在游戏过程中，我们注意到，仅仅从他们对另一个人的非语言行为来看，他们对穷人遭遇的敏感度...

sentences.en: players and were, and way more likely to talk about and showcase how well they were doing.
sentences.zh: 大大降低，而谈论和炫耀自己过得有多好则明显增加。

sentences.en: So what that tells us a little bit is that you can, you can create this kind of rigged experience
sentences.zh: 所以这在一定程度上告诉我们，你可以通过抛硬币来制造这种被操纵的特权体验，让某人在体验这种特权的同时，...

sentences.en: of privilege through the flip of a coin and get someone to experience that privilege and actually
sentences.zh: 开始表现得好像他们在某种程度上应得这种特权。

sentences.en: start to manifest as if they deserve that privilege in certain ways within an experience.
sentences.zh: 在游戏结束时，当我们请大家描述游戏为何会以这种结果结束时，我必须说明...

sentences.en: At the end of the game, when we asked people to describe why the game had ended in the way that they had, and I should
sentences.zh: 所有的富裕玩家都不可避免地赢得了游戏。

sentences.en: say that all rich players inevitably and invariably won the game.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们有着双倍的优势，这是显而易见的。

sentences.en: Of course they had twice the advantage obvious.
sentences.zh: 所以我们问富有玩家：“你为什么赢了游戏？”

sentences.en: So we asked the rich players, like, why did you win the game?
sentences.zh: 他们更有可能谈论他们所做的事情，嗯，他们在游戏中的技巧、他们的决定、他们买下的房产。

sentences.en: And they were way more likely to talk about the things that they'd done, uh, their skill at the game, their decisions, the properties they bought.
sentences.zh: 他们只是谈论自己做出的决定，而不是谈论那次抛硬币的运气，...

sentences.en: They just talk about decisions they've made as opposed to talking about that flip of the
sentences.zh: 那次抛硬币并非由于他们自身的任何行动，而是随机让他们首先体验到了那个特权地位。

sentences.en: coin that randomly and through no action of their own, got them to experience that privileged position in the first place.
sentences.zh: 现在，为了把它联系起来，就像你，你问我关于大富翁的事，我谈到想模拟现实世界的某些方面，人们可能会吹毛求疵。

sentences.en: Now, just to tie this back in, like you, you asked me about monopoly and I talked about wanting to model certain aspects of the real world and people could quibble.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，也许这就像伪装成科学的寓言，或是伪装成寓言的科学。

sentences.en: I mean, maybe this is like allegory masquerading as science or science masquerading as allegory.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为，你知道的，这项研究存在一些问题，但我认为让我印象深刻的一点是...

sentences.en: I mean, I think, you know, there's a, there's a, there's issues with the study, but I think one of the things that strikes me
sentences.zh: 在现实世界中，你会看到非常相似的模式在上演。

sentences.en: is that in the real world, you see very similar patterns unfold.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们研究财富心理学已经超过20年了。

sentences.en: Now we've studied the psychology of wealth for now more than 20 years.
sentences.zh: 人们研究过其他形式特权或地位的体验。

sentences.en: People have studied the experience of other forms of privilege or other forms of status.
sentences.zh: 所有这些研究中一个共同的洞察是，你的地位越高，我们发现你的财富越多，你的财富越丰富，...

sentences.en: And one of the uniform insights across all of that research is that the higher in status you are, and we find the higher in wealth you are, the more wealth you have,
sentences.zh: 你就会感到自己越有资格享受这种特权，也越觉得理所应当。

sentences.en: the more entitled and the more deserving of that privilege you feel.
sentences.zh: 你可能会说，好吧，当然，如果你是靠自己挣钱的，那么你当然应得这笔钱，对吧？

sentences.en: And you could say, well, of course, like if you've earned your money, then of course you deserve that money, right?
sentences.zh: 因为它是通过你自己的辛勤努力得来的。

sentences.en: Because it's come to you through your own hard effort.
sentences.zh: 但我们在许许多多的人群中对此进行了研究，包括继承了财富的人以及什么也没做却拥有财富的大学生。

sentences.en: But we've studied this among lots and lots and lots of people, including people who inherited wealth and college students who have done nothing to earn their own wealth.
sentences.zh: 你实际上会发现，在富裕的大学生、高阶层大学生中，其特权感和应得感超过了他们的父母。

sentences.en: And you actually find that among wealthy college students, high-class college students, levels of entitlement and deservingness that exceed that of their parents.
sentences.zh: 所以，富有的大学生其实并没有做什么来配得上这些。

sentences.en: So college students who are wealthy have done very little to deserve that.
sentences.zh: 他们在很大程度上生来就享有特权，就像大富翁玩家只是被随机掷硬币掷到了特权地位一样。

sentences.en: They've been born into their privilege in many, or much like the monopoly players were just sort of randomly flipped into their positions of privilege.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们觉得自己在生活中理应得到比别人更多的一切。

sentences.en: And yet they feel deserving and entitled to more than others in life.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这很有趣，而且大富翁实验为我们提供了一个有趣的视角，让我们了解...

sentences.en: So I think that's an interesting, I think, and what the monopoly experiment gives us is it's sort of an interesting insight into
sentences.zh: 人类的心智如何理解一个人所经历的特权，并将这些特权部分归因于个人的应得性、个人的功劳，而不是归因于...

sentences.en: how the human mind makes sense of the privileges that a person experiences and attributes those
sentences.zh: 运气以及世界上的种种特征——这些特征并非通过我们自身的努力，才让我们首先处于那种幸运的位置。

sentences.en: privileges in part to one's own deservingness, one's own merit, as opposed to the luck and the
sentences.zh: 我在上大学时就认识一些这样的人。

sentences.en: features of the world that through no effort of our own got us into that position of luck in the first place.
sentences.zh: 我知道你在说什么。

sentences.en: I knew some of those people in college.
sentences.zh: 我们都认识。

sentences.en: I know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我们都认识。

sentences.en: We all did.
sentences.zh: 你们发现性别差异了吗？

sentences.en: We all did.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，你知道，女性的表现是否和男性一样，你们有没有让女性和男性对决，你知道，其中的动态是怎样的？

sentences.en: Did you find gender differences?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm just curious if, you know, women behave the same way as men and did you pit women against men and, you know, what were the dynamics there?
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我想我本可以把研究设计得稍微不同一些，以便能够弄清楚是否存在真正可靠的性别效应。

sentences.en: So that's a great question.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有男性与女性对弈，女性与女性对弈。

sentences.en: I think I would have designed the study a little differently to have been able to figure out if there are really reliable gender effects.
sentences.zh: 所以我们把所有版本都交叉进行了测试。

sentences.en: So we had men playing against women, women playing against women.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们在这项研究中没有发现明显的性别差异。

sentences.en: So we had, we had all, all, uh, versions crossed.
sentences.zh: 不过我想说的是，总的来说，在我们开展的研究中，此时大概有40到50项研究，

sentences.en: We didn't find, um, major sex differences in this study, though.
sentences.zh: 考察了广泛的模式以及社会导向、社会倾向、亲社会性、不道德性、自恋、特权意识。

sentences.en: I would say generally, um, across the studies that we've run, uh, upwards of maybe let's say 40 to 50 studies at this point, looking at broad patterns and
sentences.zh: 通常来说，男性，至少是北美男性，往往在这些你可能会说是自我聚焦或自我关照的倾向方面得分更高。

sentences.en: social orientation, uh, social tendencies, uh, pro-sociality, unethicality, narcissism, entitlement.
sentences.zh: 所以男性更有竞争力。

sentences.en: Typically speaking, men, at least, uh, North American men tend to score higher in these various, you might say, self-focused or self-regarding tendencies.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我们谈论的不是重大影响。

sentences.en: So men are more competitive.
sentences.zh: 当然我指的是成千上万人的普遍模式。

sentences.en: Generally speaking, we're not talking major effects.
sentences.zh: 所以规则显然有很多例外，但总的来说，这种模式是...

sentences.en: And of course I'm talking about patterns across thousands of people.
sentences.zh: 男性通常更具竞争力，特权意识稍强一些，感觉自己更特别一点，对他人福祉的关注度稍低一些。

sentences.en: So there's obviously lots of exceptions to the rules, but generally speaking, the pattern is
sentences.zh: 有许多元分析表明了类似的差异，无论是天生的还是后天社会化的，但女性在不同方面...

sentences.en: men are typically more competitive, a little more entitled, feel a little more special, uh, a little less, uh, oriented to the wellbeing of other people.
sentences.zh: 有时是以非常微小的方式，似乎更具有同理心，更富有同情心，并且对其他人的福祉更关注。

sentences.en: And there's lots of meta-analyses that suggest similar differences, whether they're biological or socialized, but that women in, in different ways
sentences.zh: 你还做过另一项非常有趣的研究，关于汽车以及人们的行为如何取决于他们驾驶的汽车类型。

sentences.en: and sometimes in very small ways, but seem to be a little more empathetic, a little more compassionate and a little more oriented to the wellbeing of others.
sentences.zh: 你能稍微谈谈那个吗？

sentences.zh: 一种文化，无论是否不幸，它某种程度上优先考虑了近乎过度的

sentences.en: pursuits of self-interest, you know, competitiveness and meritocracy is a, you might say almost a sacred value.
sentences.zh: 对自我利益的追求，你知道的，竞争意识和精英统治可以说是近乎神圣的价值观。

sentences.en: And so if that's the case, then that's going to legitimize wealth and wealth inequalities in a way
sentences.zh: 如果情况确实如此，那么这将使财富和财富不平等合法化，

sentences.en: that more typically socially progressive or liberal countries might not where there's a stronger say
sentences.zh: 而那些更具社会进步倾向或自由主义的国家可能不会这样，在那些国家，可能存在一种更强烈的

sentences.en: explicit value toward noblesse oblige and the responsibility of sharing what you have with others, for instance, via progressive taxation.
sentences.zh: 对贵族义务（noblesse oblige）的显性价值观，以及与他人分享你所拥有之物的责任，例如通过累进税制来实现。

sentences.en: Anyway, that's a long way of saying, I think it matters.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，说这么多其实是想表达，我认为这很重要。

sentences.en: And we don't really have a lot of data yet that sort of unpacks where and why.
sentences.zh: 而我们其实还没有很多数据来剖析具体在何处以及为什么会这样。

sentences.en: We're going to take a short break.
sentences.zh: 我们要稍作休息。

sentences.en: And when we return, we'll ask Dr. Piff, whether money can buy happiness.
sentences.zh: 休息回来后，我们将询问皮夫博士，金钱是否能买来幸福。

sentences.en: There's been psychological research into the amount of money it takes to reach happiness.
sentences.zh: 一直有心理学研究在探讨达到幸福感所需要的金钱数额。

sentences.en: And there was one study, at least one study, maybe several that found that there was at $70,000, people's happiness kind of plateaus.
sentences.zh: 至少有一项研究（也许有几项）发现，在达到 7 万美元时，人们的幸福感会进入某种平台期。

sentences.en: And after that, you don't get hugely happier after making more money.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，赚更多的钱并不会让你的幸福感大幅增加。

sentences.en: I'm just wondering, does having more money make people happier?
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，拥有更多的钱真的能让人更快乐吗？

sentences.en: That's a question that moral philosophers and poets and artists and people have thought about, not just about money, but about resources for as long as we've had them.
sentences.zh: 这是道德哲学家、诗人、艺术家以及人类自拥有资源以来一直在思考的问题，不仅仅是关于金钱，而是关于资源。

sentences.en: So these are long standing questions.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是长期存在的问题。

sentences.en: And there are questions that we have some answers to, but I think the work is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 我们对这些问题有一些答案，但我认为这项研究仍在进行中。

sentences.en: There's new work that suggests that maybe, in fact, the plateau isn't at $70,000, but it's much later.
sentences.zh: 有新的研究表明，也许事实上，这个平台期不是在 7 万美元，而是在更高的水平。

sentences.en: And as your money goes up, happiness does, but the incremental value of each sort of rise in income starts to diminish.
sentences.zh: 随着你的金钱增加，幸福感确实也在增加，但收入每增加一次，其带来的边际效益就开始递减。

sentences.en: So it's almost logarithmic.
sentences.zh: 所以它几乎是对数关系。

sentences.en: So to an extent, money research tells us it buys you some version of happiness, not as much as people think it does.
sentences.zh: 因此在某种程度上，金钱研究告诉我们，它能为你买到某种版本的幸福，但没有人们想象的那么多。

sentences.en: And that effect seems to diminish as money goes up.
sentences.zh: 而且这种效应似乎会随着金钱的增加而递减。

sentences.en: But I think what's more important is that what we're also simultaneously learning,
sentences.zh: 但我认为更重要的是，我们同时也正在了解到，

sentences.en: and I'm just going to mention two different things here is to the extent that money buys you happiness, what's almost more important is how you spend the money.
sentences.zh: 我在这里只提两点，在金钱能为你买来幸福的范围内，几乎更重要的是你如何花这笔钱。

sentences.en: And we know that work, there's a lot of work that tells us that spending money on others, for instance, versus spending it on yourself buys you a
sentences.zh: 我们知道，有很多研究告诉我们，例如把钱花在别人身上，与花在自己身上相比，能为你买到

sentences.en: lot more happiness, a lot more bang for your buck, and has a much larger effect on well-being.
sentences.zh: 多得多的幸福，让你的每一块钱都更物有所值，对幸福感有大得多的影响。

sentences.en: When it comes to how to spend resources, using your money to buy yourself time, for example,
sentences.zh: 当谈到如何支配资源时，用你的钱为自己买时间，例如，

sentences.en: has a much bigger effect on happiness than does using your money to, say, buy yourself material things.
sentences.zh: 对幸福感的影响比用钱为自己买物质上的东西要大得多。

sentences.en: Buying yourself experiences over material goods is a better predictor of happiness.
sentences.zh: 比起物质商品，为自己购买体验更能准确预测幸福感。

sentences.en: What we find actually is that happiness, when you break it down, happiness is like a very complicated psychological phenomenon, right?
sentences.zh: 我们实际发现的是，当你把幸福拆解开来时，幸福就像是一个非常复杂的心理现象，对吧？

sentences.en: You can think of it as a simple word, are you happy or not?
sentences.zh: 你可以把它看作是一个简单的词，你快乐吗？

sentences.en: But in fact, when you study it, what does it even mean to people?
sentences.zh: 但事实上，当你研究它时，它对人们来说到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: If you ask someone, are you happy right now?
sentences.zh: 如果你问某人，你现在快乐吗？

sentences.en: Some people might say, well, it depends on what you mean.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会说，这取决于你指的是什么。

sentences.en: I feel content.
sentences.zh: 我感到满足。

sentences.en: I wouldn't necessarily say I'm happy.
sentences.zh: 我未必会说我是快乐的。

sentences.en: So happiness is a very multifaceted construct.
sentences.zh: 所以幸福是一个高度多维的概念。

sentences.en: And psychologists have been grappling with what kind of multifaceted construct it is.
sentences.zh: 心理学家们一直在努力搞清楚它究竟是怎样一种多维概念。

sentences.en: One of the things that we've been finding, and I think that this has been true over the last, say, 20 years as people have been thinking about the role
sentences.zh: 我们一直在发现的事情之一，而且我认为在过去大约 20 年里人们一直在思考

sentences.en: of emotions in happiness, is that happiness is actually kind of a, you might say, a gestalt state
sentences.zh: 情绪在幸福中所扮演的角色时也是如此，那就是幸福实际上是一种，你可以说是一种格式塔状态，

sentences.en: derived from our experiences of not just one emotion, but lots of different kinds of positive and maybe even negative emotions.
sentences.zh: 它源于我们不仅体验到一种情绪，还体验到许多不同种类的积极情绪甚至可能消极情绪的体验。

sentences.en: And so when we break happiness down, as we did in one study, into its composite emotions, and look at people's tendencies to experience different kinds of positive emotions,
sentences.zh: 因此，正如我们在某项研究所做的那样，当我们把幸福拆解为其组成情绪，并观察人们体验各种积极情绪的倾向时，

sentences.en: all of which contribute to this overall state of happiness, we actually find this really interesting
sentences.zh: 所有这些情绪都共同促成了这种整体的幸福状态，我们实际上发现了这样一个非常有趣的规律：

sentences.en: pattern where the wealthier you are, the more likely you are to experience certain kinds of positive
sentences.zh: 你越富有，你就越有可能体验到某些特定种类的积极

sentences.en: emotions, like pride, but the less likely you are to experience other kinds of positive emotions, like love,
sentences.zh: 情绪，比如骄傲；但你越不可能体验到其他种类的积极情绪，比如爱、

sentences.en: like compassion, like awe, that are equally, or you might even say in some cases, more powerfully connected to happiness.
sentences.zh: 比如同情、比如敬畏，而这些情绪与幸福的联系同样紧密，甚至在某些情况下你可以说联系得更加强烈。

sentences.en: So I think wealth and happiness are connected, but the ways in which wealth connects to happiness is pretty complicated.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为财富与幸福是有关联的，但财富与幸福的连接方式相当复杂。

sentences.en: And actually, it seems like wealth might buy you certain kinds of happiness, but not all of them.
sentences.zh: 事实上，看起来财富可能会为你买来某种幸福，但并非全部种类。

sentences.en: It's not an unmitigated, unequivocal good.
sentences.zh: 它并非完全毫无负面影响、毫无疑问的好事。

sentences.en: You know, I've not found this in my life, because I'm not necessarily wealthy, but people have reached out with their
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在我的人生中没有发现这一点，因为我本身并不算富有，但人们曾带着他们

sentences.en: stories of wealth, as you know, our lab and the work that we publish has gotten some traction.
sentences.zh: 关于财富的故事找到我们，正如你所知，我们的实验室以及我们发表的研究引起了一些关注。

sentences.en: And they tell me stories of like, kind of retrospectively looking back at their lives and feeling like, you know,
sentences.zh: 他们向我讲述了一些故事，比如回首往事时感到，

sentences.en: they had spent a lot of time as their money aggregated, as they gained more wealth, as they gained more status.
sentences.zh: 随着他们的金钱不断积累，随着他们获得更多财富，随着他们获得更高地位，他们花费了大量时间在上面。

sentences.en: They got more involved in their career, more focused on their numbers, more focused on working weekends and hours.
sentences.zh: 他们更多地投入到事业中，更关注自己的数字，更专注于在周末和加班工作。

sentences.en: And they lost sight of the things that in retrospect, they wish they hadn't, like their friends, their social relationships, their family, they wish they'd spent their time
sentences.zh: 而他们忽视了那些回首往事时希望自己没有忽视的东西，比如他们的朋友、他们的社交关系、他们的家人，他们希望自己曾把时间

sentences.en: differently.
sentences.zh: 花得不一样。

sentences.en: And so I think wealth and money kind of shape your value system into a particular set or constellation of things that get you to focus and prioritize on some things in life,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为财富和金钱会把你的价值体系塑造为一套特定的一组事物，让你专注于生活中的某些事情并将其置于优先地位，

sentences.en: but perhaps lose sight of some others, like your social relationships, your inherent connection to
sentences.zh: 但也许会忽视其他一些事情，比如你的社会关系、你与身边其他人

sentences.en: other people around you, and the ways in which you can derive value from those connections.
sentences.zh: 天生相连的纽带，以及你可以从这些联系中获得价值的方式。

sentences.en: And losing sight of those things are, I think, major, major determinants of your well-being and have a negative impact on it.
sentences.zh: 而忽视这些东西，我认为是决定你幸福感的重要重大因素，并会对它产生负面影响。

sentences.en: Let's talk for a minute about politics, just in a general sense.
sentences.zh: 我们花一分钟聊聊政治，就从总体意义上来说。

sentences.en: I'm wondering how wealth affects people's political attitudes.
sentences.zh: 我想知道财富如何影响人们的政治态度。

sentences.en: You know, there's a long history in this country of the well-off favoring the Republican party and being more conservative
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在这个国家，富裕阶层倾向于支持共和党并在价值观上更保守，有着悠久的历史，

sentences.en: in their values, while the Democratic party seems to be in touch with more average adults.
sentences.zh: 而民主党似乎更能触及大多数普通成年人。

sentences.en: Do the rich tend to be Republican and conservative, or is that just a stereotype?
sentences.zh: 富人倾向于成为共和党人和保守派吗？还是这只是一种刻板印象？

sentences.en: I think it's largely a stereotype.
sentences.zh: 我认为这在很大程度上是一种刻板印象。

sentences.en: You've got wealth on both sides, and lots of wealth on both sides.
sentences.zh: 你在两边都能看到财富，两边都有大量的财富。

sentences.en: Generally speaking, the work that looks at wealth and your political attitudes finds that, at least economically speaking, the wealthier you are,
sentences.zh: 总的来说，探讨财富与政治态度的研究发现，至少从经济角度来说，你越富有，

sentences.en: the more likely you are to be, let's say, economically conservative.
sentences.zh: 你就越有可能，比方说，在经济上趋于保守。

sentences.en: And what I mean by that is, if you're wealthy, you're less likely to support something like progressive taxation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你很富有，你就越不可能支持诸如累进税制之类的事情。

sentences.en: You're less likely to support redistribution in other ways.
sentences.zh: 你越不可能支持其他形式的财富再分配。

sentences.en: You're less likely to support a social safety net that offers, let's say, universal health care or universal basic income.
sentences.zh: 你越不可能支持提供诸如全民医疗保健或全民基本收入等服务的社会安全网。

sentences.en: And you're more likely to endorse attitudes and values, politicians and, you know, political policies
sentences.zh: 而且你更有可能赞同那些态度和价值观、政治家以及政治政策，

sentences.en: that you might say protect the wealthy against taxation and that help conserve privilege.
sentences.zh: 你可以说它们保护富人免受税收影响，并有助于维持特权。

sentences.en: These aren't massive effects.
sentences.zh: 这些并不是巨大的影响。

sentences.en: There are lots of different things that drive political attitudes, but it basically, I think a lot of this seems to stem from, well, if you have resources,
sentences.zh: 有很多不同的因素在驱动着政治态度，但基本上，我认为其中很大一部分似乎源于，嗯，如果你拥有资源，

sentences.en: then you're going to feel motivated to protect them.
sentences.zh: 那么你就会感到有动力去保护它们。

sentences.en: You're going to want to maintain them.
sentences.zh: 你会想要维护它们。

sentences.en: You feel deserving of them.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得自己配得上它们。

sentences.en: And so those kinds of attitudes tend to be more, at least typically associated with conservative economic policies.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些态度往往更多地、至少通常与保守的经济政策联系在一起。

sentences.en: There's even work that suggests that, you know, because you can make lots of different kinds of arguments for why that relationship might exist in the first place.
sentences.zh: 甚至有研究表明，你知道，因为你可以为这种关系为什么会首先存在提出许多不同种类的论据。

sentences.en: There's all sorts of chicken and egg stuff that you could talk about.
sentences.zh: 你可以讨论各种各样先有鸡还是先有蛋的问题。

sentences.en: There's work that finds, this is with Hazi Brown Iannuzzi, who's at the University of Virginia.
sentences.zh: 有研究发现，这是与弗吉尼亚大学的黑兹尔·布朗·尤努齐（Hazi Brown Iannuzzi）合作进行的。

sentences.en: She manipulates levels of wealth within even games and finds that if you experience privilege and status within a game,
sentences.zh: 她甚至在游戏中操纵财富水平，发现如果你在游戏中体验到特权和地位，

sentences.en: you become, economically speaking, more conservative by being less willing to support redistribution within the game.
sentences.zh: 从经济角度来说，你就会变得更加保守，因为你不愿意在游戏中支持财富再分配。

sentences.en: I think it's just a general tendency among elites to want to do things that conserve their power and privilege.
sentences.zh: 我认为这只是精英阶层的一种普遍倾向，他们想要做出能够维护自身权力和特权的事情。

sentences.en: I don't think that's only true of elites.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这只适用于精英阶层。

sentences.en: I think that's true of anyone who's in a position of power, of high status, or of privilege, that they will feel motivated to
sentences.zh: 我认为这适用于任何处于权力、高地位或特权地位的人，他们会感到有动力去

sentences.en: defend the status quo because after all, they're benefactors of it.
sentences.zh: 捍卫现状，因为毕竟他们是现状的受益者。

sentences.en: There are, of course, exceptions to that.
sentences.zh: 当然，其中也有例外。

sentences.en: But I think generally speaking, the better off you are, the more motivated you are to keep the world as it is because you're benefiting from it.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，我认为你的情况越好，你就越有动力让世界保持原样，因为你正在从中受益。

sentences.en: I mentioned in the introduction, the rise in income inequality being a huge issue in our nation, probably in the world right now.
sentences.zh: 我在引言中提到过，收入不平等加剧是我们国家、甚至可能是当今世界的一个巨大问题。

sentences.en: How do you see these psychological effects that you've been studying playing out on a more global societal
sentences.zh: 你如何看待你一直在研究的这些心理效在更全球化的社会

sentences.en: scale in terms of how we think about and deal with inequality and poverty?
sentences.zh: 层面上发挥作用，特别是在我们如何思考和应对不平等与贫困方面？

sentences.en: First of all, I'm certainly one voice among many, many, many that have talked about the very pernicious problematic effects that inequality can have on societies.
sentences.zh: 首先，在众多探讨不平等对社会可能造成的极其有害和严重影响的声音中，我当然只是其中之一。

sentences.en: And I think it's not a stretch to say that many of the issues that we face as a nation, as a species, as a planet, you could say
sentences.zh: 我认为这样说并不过分：我们作为一个国家、一个物种、一个星球所面临的许多问题，可以说

sentences.en: derive in part from the extreme levels of inequality that we're being experienced.
sentences.zh: 部分源于我们正在经历的极端不平等水平。

sentences.en: You know, you can even attribute something like the severe polarization that we're experiencing in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你甚至可以把我们目前在美国经历的严重极化现象

sentences.en: right now as resulting, at least in part, from the vast economic inequality that our population's experiencing.
sentences.zh: 归咎于，至少部分归咎于我们民众正在经历的巨大经济不平等。

sentences.en: So I think inequality is problematic for lots of reasons, in part because it makes it so difficult,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为不平等之所以是个问题，原因有很多，部分原因在于它使我们很难

sentences.en: because it's so polarizing, to come together as cohesive units to collectively confront issues we're facing.
sentences.zh: 由于这种极化，大家很难作为有凝聚力的整体团结起来，共同应对我们面临的问题。

sentences.en: So I think that our work lends a little bit of insight into the idea that inequality is problematic.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为我们的研究为“不平等是个问题”这一观点提供了一些见解。

sentences.en: And given that we're finding that the more wealth you have, the more motivated you are
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们的研究发现，你拥有的财富越多，你保护财富的动力就越强，

sentences.en: to conserve that wealth, to not want to share it with others, and to even be willing to do things
sentences.zh: 越不愿意与他人分享，甚至愿意做出

sentences.en: that break the rules to get more wealth, there's no reason to think that inequality on an individual
sentences.zh: 打破规则来获取更多财富的事情，我们没有理由认为在个人层面上不平等

sentences.en: level would necessarily change, that people would all of a sudden say, like, look, I've got enough, let me now start sharing it with others.
sentences.zh: 会必然改变，人们会突然说，看吧，我已经够了，现在让我开始和别人分享吧。

sentences.en: There doesn't seem to be that, you know, mental switch.
sentences.zh: 似乎并不存在那种，你知道的，心理上的转变。

sentences.en: The more wealth you have, the more willing you are to do things, to aggregate it, to conserve it, to conserve that privilege for yourself.
sentences.zh: 你拥有的财富越多，你越愿意去做各种事情来积累它、保护它，为自己保留这种特权。

sentences.en: And so you can expect, based on that, that inequality just gives rise to more inequality, which in turn gives rise to more inequality.
sentences.zh: 因此，基于这一点，你可以预料到，不平等只会带来更多的不平等，而这反过来又会带来更多的不平等。

sentences.en: You get something like runaway inequality that just kind of exacerbates differences between those that have and those that don't over time.
sentences.zh: 你会陷入一种失控的不平等，随着时间的推移，它只会加剧富人和穷人之间的差距。

sentences.en: Lots of people have talked about trickle-down benefits of wealth.
sentences.zh: 很多人都谈论过财富的滴漏效应（trickle-down benefits）。

sentences.en: That's part of the foundational insights of even capitalism in our country, that if you let capitalism kind of run
sentences.zh: 这也是我们国家资本主义的基本理念之一，即如果你让资本主义自由

sentences.en: wild, then the market always corrects itself in part by having those at the top sort of use their
sentences.zh: 发展，那么市场总会通过让顶层的人利用他们的

sentences.en: resources to benefit everyone, building jobs, building out different systems toward efficiency
sentences.zh: 资源造福所有人来进行自我纠正，创造就业，建立不同的效率系统，

sentences.en: that help not just them, but everyone within the population, you kind of carry people along with you.
sentences.zh: 这些系统不仅帮助他们自己，也帮助人口中的所有人，你某种程度上会带动大家一起前进。

sentences.en: We've seen politically, socially, that does not seem to be the case.
sentences.zh: 我们在政治和社会上看到的情况是，事实似乎并非如此。

sentences.en: Maybe trickle-down economics is a real thing, but trickle-down compassion doesn't seem to be.
sentences.zh: 也许滴漏式经济学是真实存在的，但滴漏式同情心似乎并不存在。

sentences.en: Now, there is a move afoot among some of these billionaires, our oligarchs in this country, to give their money away, to pledge to give their money away.
sentences.zh: 如今，在我国的一些亿万富翁和寡头中，有一股将财富捐出去、承诺捐出财富的潮流。

sentences.en: And is that coming out of a sense of guilt and pressure from others?
sentences.zh: 这难道是出于内疚感以及来自他人的压力吗？

sentences.en: I mean, or are people suddenly becoming more empathetic?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，还是人们突然变得更有同理心了？

sentences.en: It's hard to say, because I know, for instance, like the initiatives like the Giving Pledge, which are really interesting, and actually we're doing a bunch of studies on them.
sentences.zh: 很难说，因为我知道，例如像“捐赠誓言”（Giving Pledge）这样的倡议非常有趣，事实上我们正在对它们进行一系列研究。

sentences.en: I don't know what's individually motivating each of the members of the Giving Pledge, and these are billionaires who have pledged
sentences.zh: 我不知道是什么在个人层面上激励着“捐赠誓言”的每一位成员，这些亿万富翁承诺将

sentences.en: upwards of 50% of their fortunes to different charitable causes.
sentences.zh: 高达50%的财富捐给不同的慈善事业。

sentences.en: I think it's a wonderful endeavor.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一项了不起的举动。

sentences.en: I don't know what's specifically motivating them.
sentences.zh: 我不知道具体是什么在激励他们。

sentences.en: There are lots of different motivations, including some tax benefits.
sentences.zh: 有很多不同的动机，包括一些税收优惠。

sentences.en: Certainly, they're doing it in public ways, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，他们是以公开的方式这样做的，对吧？

sentences.en: So the moment you're giving away charity in a way that's being actively recognized by people,
sentences.zh: 因此，当你以一种能够被人们积极认可的方式做慈善时，

sentences.en: there's a lot of interesting benefits that you get as a result, including billionaires get to hold
sentences.zh: 你会因此获得许多有趣的利益，包括亿万富翁们得以保住数十亿资产，

sentences.en: on to billions, and just by virtue of having given some of those billions away, they are now treated as
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为他们捐出了其中的几十亿，他们现在就被视为

sentences.en: moral and good people, you know, even though they have exorbitant levels of wealth.
sentences.zh: 道德高尚的好人，你知道的，尽管他们拥有天文数字般的财富。

sentences.en: I'm not saying the Giving Pledge is a problem, but I think that the motivations for people to become members of
sentences.zh: 我并不是说“捐赠誓言”有什么问题，但我认为人们加入

sentences.en: those kinds of initiatives can be multifaceted and not necessarily pro-social.
sentences.zh: 这类倡议的动机可能是多方面的，不一定都是亲社会的。

sentences.en: There's a lot of work that suggests that actually the charity of the wealthy is often oriented toward causes that actually
sentences.zh: 有大量研究表明，事实上富人的慈善往往倾向于那些实际上

sentences.en: conserve and exacerbate inequality as opposed to mitigate it.
sentences.zh: 维护和加剧不平等，而不是减轻不平等的慈善事业。

sentences.en: So wealthy people are more likely to give to alma maters, they're more likely to give to different kinds of initiatives, even, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以富人更有可能捐给母校，他们更有可能捐给各种各样的倡议，甚至，你知道的，

sentences.en: cultural institutions that, you know, play into elites that help conserve the power of upper-class individuals as opposed to trying to mitigate it.
sentences.zh: 那些迎合精英、有助于维护上流社会个人权力的文化机构，而不是试图减轻这种不平等。

sentences.en: So I think it's a complicated answer.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是一个复杂的答案。

sentences.en: One of the questions I've gotten really interested in is the stories of wealth that people tell, particularly in
sentences.zh: 我真正感兴趣的问题之一是人们讲述的财富故事，特别是在

sentences.en: the U.S., and so for instance, something like the Giving Pledge gets a lot of traction in the news, right?
sentences.zh: 美国，比如像“捐赠誓言”这样的事情在新闻中引起了很大的反响，对吧？

sentences.en: Because people love hearing stories about how, you know, stereotypically speaking, wealthy are
sentences.zh: 因为人们喜欢听这样的故事，你知道的，按刻板印象来说，富人

sentences.en: sometimes depicted as Scrooges, but here we've got all this evidence, including Bill Gates and Warren
sentences.zh: 有时被描绘成吝啬鬼，但在这里我们有所有的证据，包括比尔·盖茨和沃伦·

sentences.en: Buffett, but so many other people of people being so philanthropic.
sentences.zh: 巴菲特，以及其他许多热心慈善的人。

sentences.en: And so newspapers tell these stories, we tell these stories, we share them almost as like heroic tales.
sentences.zh: 因此，报纸讲述这些故事，我们讲述这些故事，我们分享它们，几乎就像英雄故事一样。

sentences.en: And so we've launched a set of studies that look at the role of these stories that we tell of wealthy heroes in getting people to feel
sentences.zh: 因此，我们开展了一系列研究，探讨这些我们讲述的富有英雄的故事在让人们——

sentences.en: like, everyday people to feel like inequality might not actually be a problem.
sentences.zh: 让普通人觉得不平等其实可能不是个问题——方面所起的作用。

sentences.en: Because if it's the case that people who are wealthy are moral and good and pro-social and charitable and give their money
sentences.zh: 因为如果富人是有道德的、善良的、亲社会的、有慈善心的并且捐出了他们的钱，

sentences.en: away, well then inequality is not as problematic because those, the wealth that's being concentrated on the top just ends up getting circulated around and benefiting everyone else.
sentences.zh: 那么不平等就没有那么大问题了，因为那些集中在顶层的财富最终会流通并造福其他人。

sentences.en: And we find that that's the case.
sentences.zh: 而我们发现事实确实如此。

sentences.en: The more people have been exposed to these stories, the more people tell them, the more okay with inequality people feel, which would suggest that there's actually possibly this
sentences.zh: 人们接触这些故事越多，讲述这些故事越多，他们就越觉得不平等是可以接受的，这表明财富慈善故事的背后

sentences.en: kind of problematic, potentially problematic side to these stories of wealthy philanthropy.
sentences.zh: 其实可能存在这种有问题、潜在的有问题的阴暗面。

sentences.en: I don't think they're representative of our country's wealthy necessarily, and I think they bias the mind in some really interesting ways.
sentences.zh: 我认为它们不一定能代表我们国家的富人，而且我认为它们以非常有趣的方式扭曲了人们的心智。

sentences.en: Oh, I often like to close with the question of what you're working on next, but what are the big questions that you still want to answer?
sentences.zh: 哦，我通常喜欢以你接下来在做什么样的问题来结束，但你仍然想要解答的重大问题是什么？

sentences.en: One that we're really interested in is how do your own narratives, your own experiences with wealth, how you earned it
sentences.zh: 我们非常感兴趣的一个问题是，你自己的经历、你对财富的亲身经历——你是如何赚到它

sentences.en: versus inherited it play into the tendencies that we've really been interested in towards social connection, towards social attention, towards social attunement.
sentences.zh: 还是继承它的——如何影响我们一直非常感兴趣的社会联系、社会关注和社会契合倾向。

sentences.en: So really looking at differences in inheritance versus earning in how wealth seeps into the mind.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要真正研究继承与赚取之间的差异，看财富是如何渗入人们的心智的。

sentences.en: And you pointed at this other really interesting piece, this emotional experience of guilt.
sentences.zh: 你刚才指出了另一个非常有趣的部分，即内疚这种情感体验。

sentences.en: And so we've been in the lab now for the last six or seven years, been looking at the role of guilt, particularly in a climate of growing
sentences.zh: 所以在过去的六七年里，我们一直在实验室里研究内疚感的作用，特别是在日益加剧的

sentences.en: inequality, the role of guilt and how people experience their wealth and how that guilt, those feelings of
sentences.zh: 不平等氛围下，内疚感的作用，以及人们如何体验他们的财富，以及这种内疚感、那些

sentences.en: undeservingness play into not only how someone feels about their wealth, but also what they're willing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 不配感不仅如何影响一个人对自身财富的看法，还如何影响他们愿意用这些财富做什么。

sentences.en: So, so we've gotten interested in this idea of wealth guilt and where it comes from
sentences.zh: 所以，我们开始对这种“财富内疚感”的概念感兴趣，它从何而来，

sentences.en: and what are the ways that people go, what are the lengths that people go to assuage those feelings of
sentences.zh: 人们会为了缓解内疚感、减轻内疚感甚至试图消除内疚感而采取什么方法，付出多大的努力，

sentences.en: guilt, to mitigate them and to even try to alleviate them, not only within themselves, but to also sort of
sentences.zh: 不仅在他们自己内心，而且还要

sentences.en: demonstrate that they themselves are deserving or not as wealthy as they might appear to be.
sentences.zh: 向他人证明他们自己是配得上这些财富的，或者他们其实并没有看上去那么富有。

sentences.en: But what basically what are the different ways that people kind of confront those feelings of guilt and navigate it in various social interactions?
sentences.zh: 但基本上，人们在各种社交互动中面对和驾驭这些内疚感的方式有哪些不同？

sentences.en: So those are two projects.
sentences.zh: 所以这是两个项目。

sentences.en: And then more broadly,
sentences.zh: 更广泛地说，

sentences.en: I've gotten really interested in different kinds of psychological, you might say motivators that in some ways attenuate the wealth class differences we've been finding.
sentences.zh: 我对各种心理学上的、你可以说是驱动因素的东西产生了浓厚的兴趣，这些因素在某种程度上削弱了我们一直发现的财富阶层差异。

sentences.en: So if it's the case that wealthier individuals, that elites are generally speaking biased toward conserving their privilege or conserving
sentences.zh: 因此，如果说较富裕的个人和精英们总的来说倾向于保守他们的特权或保守

sentences.en: their power and are less attuned to the wellbeing of others and their social groups, then what are
sentences.zh: 他们的权力，并且对他人及其社会群体的福祉不那么关注，那么有哪些

sentences.en: some factors that might attenuate those differences that get them to feel a heightened sense of
sentences.zh: 因素可能会减弱这些差异，让他们对追求

sentences.en: responsibility toward the greater good, to feel more compassion for their fellow citizens, their fellow group members.
sentences.zh: 更广泛的利益产生更强烈的高度责任感，对同胞、同群体成员产生更多的同情心。

sentences.en: And so we've gotten interested in the role of compassion and more recently in how
sentences.zh: 因此我们对同理心的作用产生了兴趣，最近更是关注

sentences.en: experiences of awe, and I don't just mean experiences that you might have in the Grand Canyon or looking
sentences.zh: 敬畏体验（experiences of awe）的作用，我指的不仅仅是在大峡谷或抬头

sentences.en: up at the nightly sky, but experiences of awe sort of are characterized by feeling like you're a small
sentences.zh: 仰望夜空时可能会有的体验，而是那种以觉得自己是某个宏大事物中微小

sentences.en: part of something much bigger, how that kind of constellation of human experience can remind
sentences.zh: 一部分为特征的敬畏体验，这种人类体验的组合如何能够提醒

sentences.en: various people, not just wealthy people, but various people in various locations who belong to various
sentences.zh: 形形色色的人——不仅仅是富人，还有身处不同地点、属于不同

sentences.en: groups, that they're not just these disconnected entities and disconnected individuals, but are
sentences.zh: 群体的形形色色的人——他们不仅仅是相互脱节的实体和不相干的个人，

sentences.en: rather interconnected bits of a much larger whole that are all sort of needing to work together toward unified goals.
sentences.zh: 而是更庞大整体中相互交织的部分，都需要为了统一的目标共同努力。

sentences.en: So how do experiences of awe sort of bring people together and allow us as a species to be better equipped to confront some of our most pressing challenges?
sentences.zh: 因此，敬畏体验如何能将人们凝聚在一起，并使我们作为一个物种能够更好地装备自己去应对一些最紧迫的挑战？

sentences.en: Well, this is really interesting stuff that you're working on.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你正在研究的内容真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: I want to thank you for joining me today.
sentences.zh: 我想感谢你今天能来参加节目。

sentences.en: It's been a pleasure talking to you, Dr. Piff.
sentences.zh: 与你交谈非常愉快，皮夫博士。

sentences.en: Thanks so much, Kim.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，金。

sentences.en: It's been a lot of fun.
sentences.zh: 这真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: And I mean that.
sentences.zh: 我是认真的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.zh: 谢谢收听。

sentences.zh: 我是美国心理学协会的金·米尔斯。
